title: Download, Byte Identical
description: The CSV a dispatcher downloads should be exactly the same sequence of bytes that's sitting in the database — no re-serialization, no line-ending conversion, no silent re-generation happening at download time.
successCondition: POST /api/reporting/jobs and poll until ready. GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id/download and save the raw response body bytes. Independently, using `npm run db:psql` (or Prisma Studio's binary export), extract the raw bytes of that job's result_csv bytea column. Compare the two byte sequences: they are byte-for-byte identical (same length, same checksum/hash) — the download endpoint serves the stored bytes directly (downloadReportJob in apps/api/src/modules/reporting/service.ts just returns Buffer.from(job.resultCsv)) rather than regenerating the CSV fresh on each download.
hints: Downloading the same job twice and confirming both downloads are also byte-identical to each other is a useful extra sanity check that nothing is being regenerated per-request.
A sha256 checksum of both byte sequences is more reliable than eyeballing raw bytes for an exact-match comparison.
